description: The Sun's classical required (minimum) total shadbala is corrected from 5.0 to 6.5 rupa (BPHS ch.27 sl.32-33: 390 virupa = 6.5 rupa; corroborated by Phaladipika IV.22-23 and Pravaha sad_bala_sufficient v1.0, PR #2869). The other six values (Moon 6, Mars 5, Mercury 7, Jupiter 6.5, Venus 5.5, Saturn 5) are unchanged. Stored facts that change for the SUN only: graha_shadbala_total|required_rupa (ayanamsha INVARIANT, 1 row per chart: 5 -> 6.5; the old value 5 is integral, so the detector reports it as ONE class-level `value` change per chart) and graha_shadbala_total|ratio (achieved/required, one row per ayanamsha: the old ratio times 5/6.5; continuous, reported only as a continuous statistic). ga_structural composite strength now READS the L1 required_rupa fact instead of a shadow copy, so graha_in_house_composite_strength bphs_weighted / cross_formula_divergence for SUN_IN_HOUSE_n change only where the Sun's achieved rupa is below 6.5 (ratio is capped at 1.0): measured from stored facts, 0 rows on the native chart and Abhinandan, 120 rows on cb73cd3d (continuous). SS ruling 2026-10-02: the Rahu/Ketu composite rows (no classical required minimum) become honest nulls: per chart, 120 bphs_weighted rows (2 nodes x 12 houses x 5 ayanamshas) change tier single -> floored with value NULL, and the 120 simple_multiplication + 120 cross_formula_divergence rows disappear (continuous values: disappearance is not a class change). DECLARED citation_human change (text only, no value; SS ruling): the citation_human of all NINE graha_shadbala_total|rupa rows per ayanamsha per chart (7 classical grahas + RAH_MEAN + KET_MEAN) changes. It was a served-text defect: the lookup used the SUBJECT string ('SUN') against a Title-case table ('Sun'), silently missed, and fell back to a 5.0 default, so EVERY graha read 'vs required 5.00 rupa' (e.g. Moon 'surplus 0.65 vs required 5.00' beside a ratio row below minimum). It now states the graha's own required value (Sun 6.5, Moon 6, Mars 5, Mercury 7, Jupiter 6.5, Venus 5.5, Saturn 5) and, for the nodes, that no classical minimum exists. citation_human is not a detector field and no fact value moves. The citation_human of the composite simple_multiplication rows also changes (it printed shadbala_ratio, which the value does not use; it now prints dignity_weight and bhava_ratio). No achieved shadbala value, no other graha's required/ratio, no position, no FORENSIC anchor moves. Downstream tables outside the detector's four tables also change (ga_yoga_firings.strength via constituent_bala_v1, bodha_msr_signals.shadbala_norm, bodha_rm_resonances): see SUN_REQUIRED_RUPA_INTENT_v1_0.md.

may_change.expected_direction: SUN subject only, ONE row per chart (ayanamsha INVARIANT): 5 -> 6.5. The old value 5 is integral, so the detector classifies it class_num and reports the change as a class-level `value` change (not a continuous statistic): exactly 1 per chart compared. MOON/MAR/MER/JUP/VEN/SAT required_rupa are unchanged (6 / 5 / 7 / 6.5 / 5.5 / 5).
may_change.note: expected_count 1 = the Sun's single INVARIANT row (the other six grahas are unchanged and generate no change). Review finding LOW-5: an earlier version of this note said the predicted class-level count was 0, which was wrong. REBUILD CHECKLIST (review LOW-4): platform/src/lib/retrieval/registry/layers/__tests__/chart_query.integration.test.ts:132 asserts the LIVE Sun required_rupa == 5 and goes red the moment the rebuild lands; it is data-dependent, skipped in CI (describe.skip unless INTEGRATION=true; ci.yml unit-tests job sets neither INTEGRATION nor DATABASE_URL), and intentionally NOT edited here: flip it 5 -> 6.5 in the same step as the rebuild.

may_change.expected_direction: SUN subject only, each of 5 ayanamshas: old_ratio * 5 / 6.5, e.g. native Lahiri 1.694 -> 1.3031; Abhinandan 1.44 -> 1.1077; cb73cd3d 1.148 -> 0.8831 (flips from at/above to below the classical minimum on all 5 ayanamshas). The other six grahas' ratio is unchanged; the 'rupa' key is NOT listed because no achieved total moves.
may_change.note: No expected_count: both sides are non-integral (continuous), which the detector reports only as continuous statistics, so the predicted class-level count is 0 for this entry; a class-level change under it would be a real surprise.

may_change.expected_direction: SUN_IN_HOUSE_1..12 only, and only where the Sun's achieved shadbala rupa < 6.5 (composite normalizes min(1, rupa/required)): measured offline from stored facts, 0 rows on the native chart (rupa 8.47-8.93), 0 on Abhinandan (6.9-7.2), 120 on cb73cd3d (rupa 5.74-5.98: 12 houses x 2 keys x 5 ayanamshas). simple_multiplication does not depend on the Sun's ratio and is unchanged.
may_change.note: No expected_count: continuous values; the cb73cd3d stored rows also pre-date the P0-N1 fact_key pin, so a rebuild changes them regardless of this lane (see the intent doc).

may_change.expected_direction: RAH_MEAN_IN_HOUSE_1..12 and KET_MEAN_IN_HOUSE_1..12 only (SS ruling 2026-10-02: no classical required value for a node, so no invented normaliser; reason `no_classical_required_value_for_node`). Stored per chart (read 2026-10-02, all three charts alike): 120 bphs_weighted rows (2 nodes x 12 houses x 5 ayanamshas, tier single) -> 120 floored rows (value NULL, tier `floored`) = 120 tier changes; 120 simple_multiplication (single) and 120 cross_formula_divergence (computed_extension) rows disappear (continuous, not class changes); the chart's composite total 1620 -> 1380 rows. No stored node composite value is integral or already NULL.
may_change.note: No expected_count: a tier-honesty lane may also change tiers in this category, so a hard count could mismatch for a reason that is not this lane. The 120 per chart is the expectation, stated here for the reviewer, not machine-checked.
